title: Duluth Hillside Neighbors: "Sounds Like the Hospital Got HACKED"

fields.avatarBrief: woman in her late thirties in a winter parka and knit hat, smiling selfie on a snowy Duluth hillside with Lake Superior behind her
fields.text: My husband works nights at Lakemont and says ALL the computers went down at 2 a.m. and they're writing everything on paper. Sounds like the hospital got HACKED like those other places. Are our medical records out there now?? Anyone know more? #Duluth #Lakemont

comments.author: Gary T.
comments.text: Hacked for sure, they never admit it.

comments.author: Renee K.
comments.text: My dad is in the ICU there tonight. Nurse just told me he's fine, they're taking care of everyone, just on clipboards for now. Please don't panic people.

comments.author: Mike L.
comments.text: I had a clinic visit there last week. If my info got stolen, who am I even supposed to call at 3 in the morning??

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. A rumor in a local group calls the storage failure a hack, which pushes the PIO to write a holding statement (systems down, care going on using paper procedures, cause under investigation, next update time) and get the IC to clear it, without saying "not a cyberattack" before the Security Officer decides. Check that the Security Officer logs this post as a public claim of possible exposure, records the discovery time for the decision log and starts the rule-in/rule-out work.
